name: Poor Old Blanchy
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Poor Old Blanchy!  Such a tired beast after all the work we put her through. I fed her before we left the farm, but we weren't expecting the wagon to break on us. If you could bring her a few handfuls of oats from the fields, I'd be grateful.

I bet you could find some around all of the farms in Westfall, if you can steer clear of those horrific machines that have taken over. There are several farms southwest of here.
narrative.objectives: Verna Furlbrow in Westfall wants you to bring her 8 Handfuls of Oats.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you so much, adventurer! Poor Old Blanchy will be so happy!
narrative.requestItemsText: Old Blanchy is on her last leg. Did you happen to find any oats for her?
